# R5.10 — Seal submission and persist actual created-to-finished time

Spec: `docs/tickets/179_R5.10__seal.md` (seq 179; REQ-E-203, REQ-E-102 primary; REQ-E-103/REQ-E-201/REQ-E-204 contributing). Base `codex/harnessharness-evidence-r5.9` @`c96a471a`. Offline-only, USD 0, no production mutations.

## Summary

Implements partition X4's owner-bound slice (PADR-R5-1 A.1 item 3): the subject run's finish now seals the workspace — end-state content pin → participant-access revocation → final usage row — durably before `lifecycle.run.finished`, and M1's `wall_ms` measures the persisted `lifecycle.run.created` origin (the R-2.9.1 existing-contract fix the dossier routed beside the amendment).

- `crates/hh-ledger/src/store.rs` — seq-0 `lifecycle.run.created` carries `created_at_ms{value,measured_at:"runtime"}` on the store clock; tolerant `extra`-bucket round-trip. `tests/acceptance.rs` pins re-pinned for the additive member.
